== Acquisition ==
This skill is available while under the [[Going Commando]] disguise during the [[April Fools' Day]] quest [[Annihilator]].

== Notes ==

* Similar to [[shout]]s, characters will say ''"Gas out!"'' when this skill is activated.
* The smoke screen behaves similarly to a [[ward]].

{{anomaly|The descriptions omit that this is a [[projectile spell]].}}
